featured_reviews.name: yash chonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi. I’ve been eating from this burger place since I was 18, especially from the Malad outlet, and I’ve always loved the Jawbreaker burger. It’s something I genuinely used to crave and trust.
Unfortunately, my recent experience was very disappointing. I ordered directly from the outlet and had a Rapido partner pick it up. I ordered 'Cheese Tease' (veg burger) What I received did not match what I usually get from here. I even shared photos with them on WhatsApp and instead of acknowledging the difference, I was told it was the correct order. Literally had back & forth calls to explain this to them while opening up the order & tasting it. It took 45 mins for it to reach to me, imagine the wait I had to get this, & how excited I would be.

Just about 15 days ago, I ordered the same burgers, and everything was different then too taste, structure, spice level, and even the amount of lettuce. The recent order felt completely off: the burger was overly spicy, lacked consistency, and did not resemble the usual “Cheese tease” burger I’ve always had (there was no lettuce) It felt more like a different item altogether, possibly a super cheesy veggie variant, but definitely not what I ordered.
What made it worse was the customer support experience. I tried explaining the difference and even pointed out that the price difference was minimal (around ₹100), but there was no effort to understand or resolve the issue.
In total, I spent around ₹733 on the order and another ₹120 for pickup delivery via Rapido, and it honestly felt like a waste of money.
Very disappointed with this experience. If you want consistency, I would strongly suggest going directly to the outlet and eating there instead of ordering online or directly, because the order quality and accuracy may not be reliable.

^ In the photos above, you can clearly see the height difference of the burger, & the cheese, the burger which came had Goey cheese coming out of it, & the burger which i ordered shouldn't have that, nor i wanted. The burger which i ordered is not with a spicy potato patty, & they sent which one had. (Also ive tasted both from here, i know what they both taste like)
Quite disappointed.

Recently, I visited the Malad branch and had a much better time. Here’s what I ordered:

* OG Burger with gooey cheese – ₹300 + ₹79 — 4/5 ⭐️
* 6-inch Veg Jaw Breaker – ₹549 — 4/5 ⭐️
* Jo-gin Wedges – ₹299 — 5/5 ⭐️

Just a suggestion: if you want to try the gooey cheese, go for it, but don’t add the full portion to the burger—it becomes messy and difficult to eat.
